title: Jalapeño and Lime Coleslaw with Coriander
changes_from_base: Fresh jalapeño, lime, coriander and cumin bring a Tex-Mex edge, and buttermilk thins the creamy dressing.
summary: A zippy creamy coleslaw with jalapeño, lime, coriander and a hint of cumin; great with tacos and barbecue.
equipment: salad spinner or clean tea towel

ingredients.item: large jalapeño, deseeded and finely diced
fine sea salt or table salt, for wilting (most is rinsed off)
lime juice and 1 tsp grated zest

steps.title: Wilt
steps.text: Toss the cabbage and carrot with the wilting salt and leave 20 min in the colander. Rinse, then spin or blot completely dry.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Whisk the soured cream, buttermilk, mayonnaise, lime juice and zest, vinegar, sugar, coriander, garlic and cumin.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the vegetables and jalapeño with the dressing, taste and chill 30 min.

tips: Leave a few jalapeño seeds in for more heat.
Dry the vegetables thoroughly so the dressing clings.
Add the coriander just before serving if making ahead.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; stir before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
